notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on a tower named Alaqua in Walton County: the Forest Lookouts Florida list and Topozone, which lists a tower feature on the De Funiak Springs West topo map. Topozone is an automated map listing; its 197 ft (60 m) elevation and coordinates were not checked against a second source. The Forest Lookouts entry gives only the county and a survey code. Not used: the Florida Memory Walton County history page returned 403 on read, and anyplaceamerica.com also returned 403. A historic settlement named Alaqua, once Walton County's first county seat, shares the name; no source read ties it to the tower, so it is left out of the story. The NHLR Florida index (31 lookouts) does not name Alaqua. No source gives a status, so status stays unknown. The brief's agency value 2N is the site's township-range-section code and is proposed as unknown.
